name: One of my versions
description: The owner's half of GET /v1/versions/{id}: the same version_json() shape, for a version the caller may write (model_writable_by: their own, or a baseline's for an admin) in ANY status -- testing, verified, rejected with its reason, and the trial in progress. A route of its own rather than a parameter on the public one, because the public route is cached under a key that holds nothing about the caller. The live_sessions join is the outer FROM, so a live session always yields a row: no row is a 401, and a row whose body is null is a version the caller may not write, which answers 404 exactly as a version that does not exist.

with.name: Not the caller's version
with.description: No such version, or another competitor's.
